messages.text: What can the parliamentary records tell me about where Mary Lou McDonald represented people and the roles she held? Write a background note.

The available records can support a review of recorded constituency and Dáil-term identities, and of Bills for which Mary Lou McDonald is recorded as a sponsor and the sponsor roles attached to those Bills. They cannot establish offices held, committee or party roles, service dates, continuous tenure, or overlap with ministerial service. The reporting date supplied with the request is not treated as a research cut-off.

By “roles she held”, do you mean formal offices and committee or party roles, legislative sponsorship roles, or both? I will proceed with the available constituency, Dáil-term and sponsorship records; the tools cannot verify formal offices or committee and party roles.
